findings.issue: Reactive cancellation flag could be disposed while an awaited request remained active
findings.change: Independently owned AtomicBool cancellation flag with post-await checks; explicit ordering rationale

findings.issue: Validated quantity later used unwrap and timestamp-counter IDs lacked a strong uniqueness mechanism
findings.change: Pattern match returns validated quantity; maintained UUID v4 crate generates IDs; ambiguous responses never auto-retry mutations

findings.issue: Snapshot deadline ended after headers, before body decoding
findings.change: Keep cancellation timer alive through typed body parsing
Recommended semantic HTML from first checkpoint; incomplete controls explicitly labeled mistakes; project-specific decisions/evidence in every UI lesson
Wrap the toolbar and retain all progress controls at narrow widths

findings.issue: Empty history used null cursors while the UI expected numbers; replay sequence arithmetic could overflow.
findings.change: Optional history cursors match the schema; five-tick sequence range is checked before construction; targeted native regressions cover both.

findings.issue: Uncertain responses could be called rejected and a subsequent submit generated a new command ID.
findings.change: Classify deadline/conflict/server outcomes as uncertain. Retain exact instruction and ID, disable new input until resolved, permit same-payload retry and exact ledger lookup. Explicitly document page-lifetime retention.

findings.issue: Pause status could be overwritten by in-flight refresh; UI symbol bound disagreed with server; loopback-origin documentation differed from proxy check.
findings.change: Derive refresh completion label from current pause state; enforce 1–8-letter symbols; use documented 127.0.0.1 origin and bounded exact-order proxy route.

findings.issue: Stage assessment anchors and source-directory links were not portable static targets.
findings.change: Use actual gate anchors and project HTML/manifests. Static checker now reports zero missing links and exact source correspondence.

findings.issue: Rejecting a later retry does not establish that an earlier uncertain write failed.
findings.change: Retain pending identity across any retry rejection; only confirmed success or exact matching ledger reconciliation resolves it. Native regression covers401/422/429 after an uncertain attempt.

findings.issue: The loopback proxy previously admitted unlimited handler threads and idle incomplete bodies.
findings.change: Admit at most16 connections before spawning threads; reject excess with503 and apply a5-second idle socket timeout. Actual socket fixture confirms rejection and slot recovery; no total request deadline or public deployment claim.

findings.issue: A static WASM-package import failed before its error handler when the portable package had not yet been built.
findings.change: Visible startup/build instructions plus a dynamic import inside try/catch handle absent generated files. Inline JavaScript syntax checked; real-browser gate stays pending.

verification.browser: blocked: browser tool reported user declined localhost access
verification.code_snippets: regenerated from source and hash-checked by build-course.py
verification.wasm_clippy: passed with-Dwarnings for final Rust UI source; verification/ui-clippy.log
